findings.lens: Pentecostal (Assemblies of God Statement of Fundamental Truths)
findings.claim: Coordinates [80, 85, 5, 75, 85, 90] are directionally right but sit low on grace and kingdom relative to how an informed AG member answers; the entry lands nearest in the simulation (17.03) but would fit better at grace 85 and kingdom 80.
findings.evidence: Simulation scores grace 92 and kingdom 83; the AG requires a pretribulational rapture of its ministers (Bylaws Art. IX.B) and rejects unconditional election, so typical members answer S2 and S12 at +2. With grace 85 and kingdom 80 the distance becomes sqrt(49+49+25+9+4+4)=sqrt(140)=11.83 (95%) with no change to any other tradition's nearest result (Charismatic non-denom stays at 34.50).
